title: Texas Standard for Sept. 25, 2026: Texas voter registration backlog leaves thousands of applications unprocessed
summary: Tens of thousands of Texas voter registration applications — some submitted at least a year ago — remain unprocessed ahead of the November midterms. County election officials have linked the...
content: Tens of thousands of Texas voter registration applications — some submitted at least a year ago — remain unprocessed ahead of the November midterms. County election officials have linked the backlog to a Texas Department of Public Safety error, while DPS says the issue has been resolved. Source
